rationale: The agent followed policy throughout. It verified the user by matching full name and ZIP to a single account before accessing data. It used read-only tools to retrieve user, order, and product details. Before making any write changes, it clearly stated the intended updates and obtained explicit confirmation: first to update both pending orders’ shipping addresses, then to modify the jigsaw item and confirm the payment method for any price difference. The address updates were executed correctly for both orders, and the change to the jigsaw was made to the most suitable available variant (500 pieces, beginner), with the resulting refund to PayPal accurately reflected. All shared information matches tool outputs, and there were no unsupported claims or unauthorized actions. Although the initial persona mentioned potentially updating the user profile address, the user only confirmed changes to the orders; the agent correctly limited changes to the confirmed scope.
